title: Ashen Delta: The Cartographer's Tide Ledger
premise: In a marsh where glass reeds record vanished flood levels, the cartographer must chart hidden passages before nightfall using a living contour chart.
ending: Recover the Tide Ledger and return with the charted evacuation line; Delta Ferrymen can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive silt lightning while evading the drowned warden without sacrificing the charted evacuation line.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Delta Ferrymen to witness the living contour chart.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to publish an unsafe shortcut
